description: This file is a shell script for handling platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWRT build environment. It defines functions to check images and perform upgrades based on the board name, with a default upgrade method.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that checks the firmware image before upgrade; always returns success in this implementation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the platform-specific upgrade; calls default or specific upgrade routines based on board name.
